verdict.rationale: Mercado Pago's own docs have a dedicated MP CLI page (mp-cli/overview). It says a single token lets users operate payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores and reports without a browser, visual client or manual HTTP calls, so an official CLI exists and covers the core resources. The evidence is a single overview snippet, though, so depth and AI-agent ergonomics are unproven. Missing for 10: documented installation and command reference, explicit AI/agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output, non-interactive use by agents), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
